d: THE GLOAMING WATCH #2 — Shadows over Gloam City. Vexnetha spots it first: silence where gulls should be, at the edge of Lantern Row. Starring Olrineus (Emar Deldine), Vexnetha (Lusha Helkem). Lantern-keepers patrol the fog city after dark, solving the small strange mysteries the daylight misses.
